sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A small rosette agave native to central Mexico, typically about 0.5 m tall and 0.2–0.4 m wide. Its stiff, narrow green leaves bear white marginal filaments. Horticultural references give a flower stalk about 2–2.5 m tall; flowers vary in colour and can be yellow, though that form is rare.

sections.title: Uses and safety
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish species-specific food use or food toxicity.
